hypothesis: For F rows, the official previous-game success rates are game-type-local often enough to avoid the R-to-F contamination found in the all-season cumulative counter. Decoding their shared success/middle denominator permits a row-local Bayesian update that can follow the documented F measurement-regime shift.

decoder.workload: LCM of the reduced denominators of official previous-N-game success and middle rates

formula: on F only, (decoded_successes + k * parent) / (decoded_n + k); R remains parent

ranking: maximum minimum F score gain across 2020 and 2021
source_selection.on_pass: freeze horizon and k as an F route before any 2022/2023 evaluation
